changelog:
WHAT'S NEW
Plex: a short "Getting Plex ready…" while every Home rail and its posters load, so the screen is smooth the moment it appears instead of stuttering while rows arrive behind the remote. Capped at nine seconds; a slow server shows Home with what has landed.

Plus everything in 1.7.6: Plex opens lighter and kinder to small boxes, and nothing adult on the content bar or the Plex Home, Discover and Search rails.
releaseNotes: Version 1.7.7 settles Plex before it appears, so Home is smooth from the first press. Installs normally over 1.7.6.
